title: broken tooths scraping against torn elbows bent at junctures of self only point to protuberance of sustenance who steal mana from the willing #smallpo
summary: broken tooths scraping against torn elbows bent at junctures of self only point to protuberance of sustenance who steal mana from the willing #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
broken tooths
scraping against
torn elbows bent
at junctures of self
only point
to protuberance
of sustenance
who steal
mana from the
willing
#smallpoems
